title: Halves and Quarters
seo_title: Grade 1 Halves and Quarters Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Illustrate 1/2 and 1/4 as parts of a whole; compare 1/2 and 1/4 using models; count halves and quarters.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 halves and quarters worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: equal parts, halves and quarters of shapes and amounts, comparing and counting. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts; a quarter is 1 of 4.
key_sub: 1/2 is bigger than 1/4 of the same whole.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A half (12) is 1 of 2 equal parts. A quarter (14) is 1 of 4 equal parts.
  • The parts must be the same size.
  • 2 halves make 1 whole. 4 quarters make 1 whole.
  • A half of a pizza is bigger than a quarter of the same pizza.

Examples

Example

Cut a cake into 4 equal parts

each part is 1 quarter

Answer: 4 quarters = 1 whole

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Unequal partsHalves and quarters must be equal.
1/4 bigger than 1/2More parts means smaller parts.
Counting the cutsCount the parts.
